sloka: न हि राज्ञः सुताः सर्वे राज्ये तिष्ठन्ति भामिनि ।स्थाप्यमानेषु सर्वेषु सुमहाननयो भवेत् ॥२-८-२३॥
transliteration: na hi rājñaḥ sutāḥ sarve rājye tiṣṭhanti bhāmini ।sthāpyamāneṣu sarveṣu sumahānanayo bhavet ॥2-8-23॥

translations.english: O lovely lady, not all the sons of the king will inherit the kingdom. If all of them are installed as kings, there will be great disorder.
